How do 99-year prepaid leasehold townhomes in Tsawwassen North work?

Townhomes in Tsawwassen North sit on Tsawwassen First Nation treaty land under a 99-year lease that has already been prepaid by the developer. Owners pay monthly strata fees and annual property taxes (set to match City of Delta rates) with no monthly ground-rent payment.
What are typical monthly strata fees for Tsawwassen townhomes?
Monthly strata fees for Tsawwassen townhomes typically range from $290 to $520 depending on unit size, complex age, landscaping coverage, and whether a clubhouse or gym is included.
Are there rancher-style (single-level) townhomes in Tsawwassen?

Yes. Several older freehold townhome complexes in Tsawwassen Central and Beach Grove feature 1-level rancher or main-floor-primary layouts popular with downsizers, though they sometimes sell near or above the $1.2M threshold depending on renovations.

Tsawwassen townhome neighbourhoods fall within Delta School District 37 (Cliff Drive Elementary, Beach Grove Elementary, South Park Elementary, and South Delta Secondary School), plus private K–12 IB school Southpointe Academy.
Are pets and rentals allowed in Tsawwassen townhomes?

Long-term rentals are permitted under BC Strata Property Act rules (outside compliant 55+ complexes), and most Tsawwassen townhome strata corporations allow 1 or 2 dogs or cats. Always verify exact bylaws on the Form B Information Certificate.
